# Apex

Apex is a simple, distraction-free theme built around monospaced type and a plain interface. Its recorded description is aimed at keyboard-first use, naming hotkeys and Vim-style keybindings for moving through the app, and it records that the theme works best on macOS.

![Apex screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clearlysid/apex/HEAD/preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Apex"
    author: "clearlysid"
    repo:   "clearlysid/apex"
    slug:   "apex"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/apex"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/clearlysid/apex"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/clearlysid/apex/HEAD/preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a simple, distraction-free theme with monospaced type and a clean UI for focused writing. Navigate with hotkeys and Vim-style keybinds for fast, keyboard-first workflows; works best on macOS."
}
```
